decisions.title: Approve the expanded Foundry 2.0 design before tasks?
Approve the open-source Rust and Weight IR design before tasks?
What should change in the design?
decisions.answer: Make user gyms first-class; expand Weight IR details; clarify Rust/Python boundaries with Python-first gym authoring and research APIs.

decisions.title: Approve the first-class gym portfolio and expanded Weight IR design before tasks?
decisions.answer: Revise design: reject in-process generated gyms; define non-writing gradient attribution as logged inspection; make contracts, three-way splits, verification, export, construction, transfer, method/evidence ledgers, library lifecycle, and reporting explicit gates.

decisions.title: Approve the isolation, attribution classification, and compliance-gate design before tasks?
decisions.answer: Revise design around five smaller milestones, a standalone Gym Scientist, an explicit Transformation Search Space, cross-model intervention learning, and an autonomous unseen-pretrained-model repair flagship.
